why_seated: HICETAS, UT AIT THEOPHRASTUS. Lucullus 123: Hicetas of Syracuse, as Theophrastus says, holds that the heaven and all above stand and the earth alone turns about its axis, and that all comes out the same as if the earth stood; the first source Copernicus names.
